Outside the compound nearby, there is a masjid (8-10 minutes walking distance) where 5 times namaz takes place with Azaan, and Jumma prayers aswell. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Jumuah & Eid Prayers Question ID: 805 Country: United Kingdom Title: Is it permissible under shariah to make short announcements regarding masjid finances and forthcoming events after finishing the english bayaan but before the first azaan for Friday Prayers? Question: Is it permissible under shariah to make short announcements regarding masjid finances and forthcoming events after finishing the english bayaan but before the first azaan for Friday Prayers? Answer ID: 805 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 965=703/H) In your mosque, English speech is before first Azaan, after first Azaan the people pray Sunnah salah, then second Azaan and Khutba take place; if the order is so then short and necessary announcements can be made provided it causes no delay in second Azaan and there is no fear of any disturbance. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
